integrity: The covariance formula is derived by conditioning a single pair-collision indicator on whether each category appears. The sign theorem reduces to an exact antitonic covariance inequality under the size-biased category law. Exhaustive finite sample-space enumeration and exact-rational profile tests replay the formulas but do not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a covariance-sign and finite-sample lower-bound result, not a claim of positive association or stochastic monotonicity.
The parent categorical law is assumed to have finite positive support.
Older occupancy or diversity-index literature may encode the same covariance identity under different notation.
title: Universal positive covariance of sample richness and unbiased Gini–Simpson diversity
